title: Narrative Visual Debt & Payoff Model
description: Tracks pending narrative expectations created by spoken promises without enforcing mandatory or rigid cut rules.
core_principles: Visual Debt represents pending viewer expectation created when the script promises, describes, or references a visual element not yet shown.
Visual Debt heightens the contextual relevance of visual payoff, but does NOT enforce a mandatory cut, media switch, specific technique, fixed timestamp, or literal representation.
Payoff can occur through cutting to B-roll, evolving current framing, or remaining on presenter when human performance already satisfies the narrative beat.
Unresolved debt that extends past the relevant narrative unit expires or transitions naturally without breaking the edit.

debt_lifecycle.creation: Script or presenter introduces an unseen feature, metric, or location.
debt_lifecycle.elevation: Viewer curiosity builds as description continues without visual manifestation.
resolution_modes: SWITCH_PAYOFF: Cutting to relevant B-roll / asset showing the described element.
IN_STATE_PAYOFF: Presenter gesture, expression, or existing framing organically fulfills the moment.
GRAPHIC_PAYOFF: Clean minimal typographic or icon cue anchors the claim.
NARRATIVE_TRANSITION: The topic moves to another subject and debt naturally decays without forced cut.
